title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - Batch
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/Batch . A uniform collection of tangible objects or Lot: either a collection of produced items (outflow of products) or a collection of raw material or required material (inflow of products). It is assumed the objects in a batch are similar and thus share attributes. Subclass of the external saref:FeatureOfInterest class (SAREF core). ItemBatch and MaterialBatch are its concrete SAREF4INMA subclasses; their own additional properties are documented on those models, while the properties below (declared directly on Batch) are inherited by both and not repeated there.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Batch'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasIdentifier.description: Relationship. Links the batch to its unique identifier (e.g. a GTIN, IRDI or UUID instance). Target model: 'ID'.

hasSize.description: Relationship. The size of the batch, i.e. the amount of objects it contains (at most one Size). Target model: 'Size'.

needsEquipment.description: Relationship. Indicates that producing this batch needs a particular production equipment. Target model: 'ProductionEquipment'.

consistsOf.description: Relationship. A batch can recursively consist of other (sub-)batches. Target model: 'Batch'.
